text: “You were as kind as possible; but I have had to get a few things since——” “What kind of things? How much have you spent? Let me see the bill—I daresay the woman is swindling you.” “Oh, no, I think not: clothes have grown so frightfully expensive; and one needs so many different kinds, with country visits, and golf and skating, and Aiken and Tuxedo——” “Let me see the bill,” Mrs. Peniston repeated.
